records.stateBefore: Demand approved; transport service not yet committed.
records.event: evt-shipment-requested · shipment service requested
records.decision: Is Road LTL eligible for cargo, lane, service and required date?
records.rule: Serviceability, commodity, size/weight, prohibited-goods, lane, cut-off and contract rules must pass.
records.control: Eligibility rule version and override authority recorded.
records.action: Create or reject the transport service request with reason.
records.evidence: Eligibility result, rule version, request timestamp and rejection/override record.
records.stateAfter: LTL service request ELIGIBLE or REJECTED.
records.outcome: Valid demand enters rating and commitment without silent scope assumptions.

records.stateBefore: Service eligible; class, rate and charge basis unresolved.
records.event: Rate/classification requested or recalculation triggered.
records.decision: Which classification, tariff/contract rate, accessorial basis and service offer apply?
records.rule: Use contract/tariff hierarchy, effective dates, verified attributes and approval tolerances; NMFC only in its applicable North-American relationship.
records.control: Preserve input measures, classification/rate version, exception approvals and quoted-to-executed linkage.
records.action: Determine class/rating basis, calculate offer and record commitment or controlled referral.
records.evidence: Class/rate response, source/version, charge components, approval and quote.
records.stateAfter: Commercial offer COMMITTED, REFERRED or REJECTED.
records.outcome: Traceable price and expected cost without treating classification as a global taxonomy.

records.stateBefore: Commercial commitment exists; execution identities/doc state incomplete.
records.event: Shipment/consignment and BOL/eBOL or consignment-note creation requested.
records.decision: Are parties, locations, cargo, references and document form complete and mutually consistent?
records.rule: Reuse Page‑0 atomic objects; distinguish shipment, consignment and transport document; apply eBOL, CMR/e-CMR or national form only when scope resolves.
records.control: Uniqueness, required-field, version, duplicate and amendment controls.
records.action: Create canonical shipment/consignment records and issue or prepare the applicable transport document.
records.evidence: Versioned shipment, transport document, validation response and identifier crosswalk.
records.stateAfter: Execution identity VALIDATED or BLOCKED.
records.outcome: One traceable identity spine across commercial, physical and financial records.

records.stateBefore: Shipment valid; pickup not yet accepted; freight may not be ready.
records.event: evt-booking-requested · pickup/service request submitted.
records.decision: Can the carrier/service accept requested location, window, quantity and freight readiness?
records.rule: Valid identity, serviceability, pickup window, cargo readiness and condition-specific prerequisites required.
records.control: Request/response correlation, idempotency, change/cancel reason and stale-version rejection.
records.action: Schedule, update/reschedule or cancel pickup and publish response.
records.evidence: Pickup request, acknowledgement/status, appointment and change history.
records.stateAfter: Pickup ACCEPTED, CONDITIONAL, REJECTED or CANCELLED.
records.outcome: Executable pickup commitment synchronized with shipper and carrier.

records.stateBefore: Pickup planned; vehicle/equipment/qualified resource not yet proven available.
records.event: Equipment or resource assignment proposed.
records.decision: Is the assigned resource available, suitable, inspected and qualified for active conditions?
records.rule: Capacity, compatibility, maintenance, inspection, qualification and condition-specific requirements must pass.
records.control: Authoritative availability/inspection record and controlled override.
records.action: Allocate, inspect, substitute or block resource.
records.evidence: Assignment, availability state, inspection/qualification evidence and exception approval.
records.stateAfter: Resource READY or BLOCKED.
records.outcome: Safe and feasible execution capacity.

records.stateBefore: Carrier not yet in custody; pickup commitment open.
records.event: evt-pickup-dispatched followed by physical acceptance or refusal.
records.decision: Does presented freight match the accepted request/document and acceptance criteria?
records.rule: Identity, count, apparent condition, prohibited/controlled-goods and document checks must pass or reservations/refusal be recorded.
records.control: Positive identity match, timestamp/location, condition/count variance and custody acknowledgement.
records.action: Dispatch, inspect presented freight, accept with/without reservation, or refuse with reason.
records.evidence: Dispatch event, pickup scan, receipt/BOL acknowledgement, count/condition record and reservation/refusal.
records.stateAfter: Custody ACCEPTED, ACCEPTED WITH RESERVATION or REFUSED.
records.outcome: Provable custody start and freight state.

records.stateBefore: Carrier custody active; origin-node receipt not reconciled.
records.event: Arrival/receiving scan and inspection recorded.
records.decision: Do handling-unit identity, count, weight/dimensions, condition and routing attributes reconcile?
records.rule: Receive only against authoritative shipment/handling-unit identity; quarantine or case any discrepancy.
records.control: Scan/measurement provenance, scale/device validity where required, duplicate/missing-unit and damage controls.
records.action: Unload, identify, inspect, measure/reweigh where controlled, receive or hold.
records.evidence: Node receipt, scans, measurements, condition images/records and variance case.
records.stateAfter: Handling units RECEIVED, HELD or EXCEPTION.
records.outcome: Reliable origin inventory/custody state for network planning.

records.stateBefore: Freight at origin node; outbound load not authorized.
records.event: Consolidation/load-build proposal created or changed.
records.decision: Which handling units can share the planned vehicle/route while meeting service and condition constraints?
records.rule: Capacity, route, compatibility, segregation, cut-off, custody and load-integrity rules must pass.
records.control: Planned-versus-scanned unit reconciliation and supervisor release for exceptions.
records.action: Group handling units, assign route/leg/equipment, stage/load and authorize departure.
records.evidence: Load plan, manifest, scan reconciliation, seal/closure evidence where used and release.
records.stateAfter: Origin load BUILT and AUTHORIZED or BLOCKED.
records.outcome: Feasible consolidated movement with complete unit lineage.

records.stateBefore: Load authorized at origin/intermediate node.
records.event: Departure, in-transit observation, arrival or deviation event.
records.decision: Can the leg continue within route, hours, safety, condition and service constraints?
records.rule: Only authorized load/resource may depart; actual events must preserve leg, load and unit correlation.
records.control: Departure gate, route/deviation monitoring, event chronology and unresolved-hold block.
records.action: Depart, move, update actual state, arrive or safely stop/escalate.
records.evidence: Departure/arrival events, location/time, load/resource identity and deviation evidence.
records.stateAfter: Leg IN TRANSIT, ARRIVED, STOPPED or EXCEPTION.
records.outcome: Observable movement state and reliable downstream ETA/service evidence.

records.stateBefore: Handling units contained in arrived load; next-leg assignment pending.
records.event: Unload/transfer scan and sort decision.
records.decision: Does each unit reconcile and which outbound route/door/load should receive it?
records.rule: Positive identity, custody continuity, route eligibility, condition and cut-off controls must pass; unresolved units move to exception state.
records.control: Inbound-to-outbound scan reconciliation, missort prevention, damage/shortage capture and controlled release.
records.action: Unload, scan, sort, stage, cross-dock, hold or redirect.
records.evidence: Transfer events, location/door, unit/load containment, condition and outbound assignment.
records.stateAfter: Unit TRANSFERRED, STAGED, HELD, MISSORTED or EXCEPTION.
records.outcome: Network connection achieved without losing custody or identity lineage.

records.stateBefore: Unit available at transfer node; successor custody/leg unresolved.
records.event: Transfer/interchange offer, acceptance and handoff event.
records.decision: Is the successor party/leg authorized, ready and compatible with the active contract/regime/condition?
records.rule: Leg-by-leg carrier, contract, document, custody and legal scope must be resolved; do not merge regimes.
records.control: Successor identity/authority, handoff evidence, document correlation and unresolved-scope lock.
records.action: Offer, accept/reject, hand over and open the next leg; or hold/escalate.
records.evidence: Interchange receipt, custody record, successor leg ID, document link and timestamps.
records.stateAfter: Successor leg OPEN and custody ACKNOWLEDGED, or transfer BLOCKED.
records.outcome: Leg-level composability without false end-to-end legal simplification.

records.stateBefore: Inbound consolidated load arrived; delivery units/routes not ready.
records.event: Destination receipt, deconsolidation and route-build event.
records.decision: Which units are releasable and which route/stop/appointment can execute them?
records.rule: Receipt reconciliation, active holds, service/recipient constraints, route capacity and delivery readiness must pass.
records.control: Inbound/unit reconciliation, hold block, route assignment and planned-versus-loaded check.
records.action: Unload, deconsolidate, stage, assign route/stop and build delivery load.
records.evidence: Destination receipt, unit state, route/stop/load plan and release.
records.stateAfter: Delivery load READY or unit HELD/EXCEPTION.
records.outcome: Reliable handoff from transportation to destination/last-mile execution.

records.stateBefore: Destination load prepared; recipient/site readiness unresolved.
records.event: Appointment/readiness response and dispatch event.
records.decision: Can the shipment be dispatched to the recipient/site under active instructions, restrictions and window?
records.rule: Valid recipient/location, appointment, access constraints, holds, service and special-condition prerequisites required.
records.control: Latest-instruction/version check, hold check, appointment acknowledgement and dispatch authority.
records.action: Confirm/reschedule appointment, dispatch, hold or redirect.
records.evidence: Appointment response, recipient instruction, dispatch and change record.
records.stateAfter: Delivery DISPATCHED, RESCHEDULED or HELD.
records.outcome: Executable destination commitment and reduced failed attempts.

records.stateBefore: Shipment out for delivery; carrier custody active.
records.event: evt-delivery-attempted and, when successful, evt-pod-captured.
records.decision: Was delivery completed to an authorized recipient/site, refused, short/damaged or unsuccessful?
records.rule: Identity, authorization, actual count/condition, exception reason and applicable signature/evidence requirements must pass.
records.control: Geotime/user/device provenance, tamper-resistant evidence, reservation/refusal and failed-attempt reason controls.
records.action: Deliver and obtain acceptance/reservation, or record failed attempt/refusal and trigger recovery.
records.evidence: POD/acceptance, delivery attempt, recipient, count/condition, reservation/refusal and location/time.
records.stateAfter: DELIVERED / DELIVERED WITH RESERVATION / FAILED / REFUSED.
records.outcome: Provable service completion or actionable exception with custody state.

records.stateBefore: Execution state deviates or evidence is absent/inconsistent.
records.event: evt-exception-detected.
records.decision: What is the failure class, severity, affected object, true detection point and accountable recovery owner?
records.rule: Do not assign root cause to detection location; correlate object lineage, upstream process, system/role and downstream impact.
records.control: Duplicate-case prevention, severity model, owner/clock assignment and evidence preservation.
records.action: Open/classify case, preserve evidence, assign owner and response clock, communicate/escalate.
records.evidence: Exception case, variance, affected object/version, detection signal, owner and clock.
records.stateAfter: Exception DETECTED, CLASSIFIED and OWNED.
records.outcome: Recovery starts from evidence before the response window is lost.

records.stateBefore: Exception open; affected freight/service/financial state unresolved.
records.event: Recovery option proposed, authorized, executed and evidenced.
records.decision: Which feasible action contains risk and restores an authorized execution state with least justified consequence?
records.rule: Recovery cannot precede detection/ownership; respect holds, custody, contract, safety and legal scope.
records.control: Decision record, authority, alternative evaluation, action confirmation, state reconciliation and closure evidence.
records.action: Hold, rework, redirect, redeliver, return, substitute, communicate, settle or escalate as permitted.
records.evidence: Decision, authorized action, actual recovery event, reconciled objects and closure approval.
records.stateAfter: RECOVERED to a valid process state, ESCALATED, or CLOSED WITH CONSEQUENCE.
records.outcome: Controlled service recovery and preserved learning/evidence.

records.stateBefore: Quoted/planned charge exists; executed charge state incomplete.
records.event: Preliminary charge/reweigh/reclass/accessorial notification or billable-completion event.
records.decision: Which evidenced, contractually valid charges or changes can be accrued/billed/referred?
records.rule: Reconcile contract/rate version, measured facts, service events, accessorial evidence, tax context and approval tolerance.
records.control: Quote-to-charge comparison, duplicate charge, effective-rate, evidence and approval controls.
records.action: Calculate preliminary/executed charges; accrue, refer variance or publish billable amount.
records.evidence: Charge lines, rate basis, measures, events, variance reason and approval.
records.stateAfter: Charge PRELIMINARY, ACCRUED, BILLABLE or IN DISPUTE.
records.outcome: Timely, explainable freight economics and reduced leakage.

records.stateBefore: Charge recognized; invoice/payment state not controlled.
records.event: Invoice received/issued, audit result, approval and settlement event.
records.decision: Does invoice/receivable reconcile to contract, rate, shipment, performed service, evidence, tax and tolerance?
records.rule: No approval without authoritative charge/evidence; preserve original invoice and controlled adjustment; segregate duties.
records.control: Duplicate, three-way/evidence match, tolerance, approval, beneficiary and payment-release controls.
records.action: Issue/receive, validate, match, approve, reject/dispute, post and settle.
records.evidence: Invoice, audit result, approval, posting, payment/receipt and settlement reference.
records.stateAfter: INVOICED, APPROVED, DISPUTED, PAID/COLLECTED or SETTLED.
records.outcome: Accurate cash and cost with operational lineage.

records.stateBefore: Issue alleged; standing, liability/charge basis, quantum and time state unresolved.
records.event: Claim/dispute filed, acknowledged, evaluated, decided and settled/declined.
records.decision: Does claimant have standing and do contract/regime, evidence, causation, time bar, liability/charge and quantum support relief?
records.rule: Keep cargo/service claim, billing dispute and insurance recovery separate; apply only resolved contract/regime/policy.
records.control: Completeness, evidence integrity, conflict, reserve, authority, time-bar and settlement controls.
records.action: Acknowledge, investigate, request evidence, reserve, decide, settle/decline and pursue recovery/subrogation where valid.
records.evidence: Claim file, liability/coverage position, decision, settlement/decline and recovery evidence.
records.stateAfter: CLAIM/DISPUTE SETTLED, DECLINED, WITHDRAWN or ESCALATED.
records.outcome: Controlled financial/customer resolution without invented liability.

records.stateBefore: Execution case exists; applicable authority/instrument and release state unresolved.
records.event: Scope determination, filing/response, inspection, hold or release event.
records.decision: Which operative authority/instrument and participant duty apply to this lane, goods, party, facility and procedure?
records.rule: No regime loads from mode name alone; resolve legal scope separately and block movement when an operative hold exists.
records.control: Source/effective-date record, filing correlation, authority-response provenance and hold-release segregation.
records.action: Classify/screen, file where required, receive response, inspect, hold, release or escalate.
records.evidence: Scope record, declaration/shipping paper, authority response, inspection, hold/release and retained evidence.
records.stateAfter: REGULATORY STATUS RESOLVED, HELD, RELEASED or RESEARCH REQUIRED.
records.outcome: Compliant execution without jurisdictional overgeneralization.

records.stateBefore: Two or more records cannot be reliably correlated.
records.event: Identity mismatch or master/reference-data exception detected.
records.decision: Which authoritative identity/version and relationship survives for the governed scope?
records.rule: Apply Page‑0 object authority; never merge shipment, consignment, handling unit, document or equipment into one compound object.
records.control: Stewardship, survivorship, version, uniqueness and consumer acknowledgement.
records.action: Resolve, map, correct, republish and acknowledge trusted identity/version.
records.evidence: Crosswalk, stewardship decision, source/version, changed records and consumer acknowledgements.
records.stateAfter: Identity RECONCILED or execution BLOCKED.
records.outcome: No silent identity drift across shipper, carrier, node and finance.

records.stateBefore: Customer outcome or information need unresolved.
records.event: Service request/contact received, response/action communicated and resolution accepted or escalated.
records.decision: What authenticated, authorized and evidenced response/action can be provided without contradicting execution truth?
records.rule: Use authoritative shipment/case state; protect data; do not promise recovery/credit outside authority.
records.control: Identity/authentication, case linkage, SLA, approval and communication-history controls.
records.action: Acknowledge, explain, coordinate, notify, resolve or escalate.
records.evidence: Service request, authenticated party, response, commitment, resolution and feedback.
records.stateAfter: Customer case RESOLVED, WAITING, ESCALATED or linked to recovery/claim.
records.outcome: Consistent service communication and preserved customer evidence.
